title: Paper Towns
author: John Green
summary: After the girl next door takes him on an all-night spree of revenge pranks, Quentin wakes to find she has vanished. He and his friends follow her clues in the days before graduation.
readIf: you like a funny, thoughtful teen mystery that is really about how we imagine other people.
skipIf: you want an easy romance, because the story deliberately avoids a tidy one.

pairings.reason: Another novel about a restless boy and the girl he cannot read, with more emotional weight.
A more grounded teen romance with real people instead of dreamed-up ones.
The author's best-known book, with more humour and more heartbreak.
